name: qq
description: Chrona's private QQ bot: owner binding, the qq:dm conversation (through chat), approval buttons, and the QQ channel for the notify module.

tools.name: deliver
tools.description: Send one notification to the bound owner. Returns the delivery outcome; never retried by Chrona.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: A reply in the qq:dm conversation: a passive reply to the message it answers while that window lasts, otherwise through notify.send.

attachments.description: JSON array of the reply's files, with appId
